Rewrite every power with base five

question:
Find the value of \(x\) that satisfies the equation

\[25^{-2} = \dfrac{5^{\frac{48}{x}}}{5^{\frac{26}{x}} \cdot 25^{\frac{17}{x}}}.\]
solution:
Because \(x\) occurs in the exponent denominators, we must have \(x\ne0\). For such \(x\), all the powers in the large denominator are positive, so that denominator is nonzero.

The relation \(25=5^2\) lets us combine all powers using one base:
\[
25^{-2}=5^{-4},\qquad 25^{17/x}=5^{34/x}.
\]
The right side becomes
\[
\frac{5^{48/x}}{5^{26/x}\cdot5^{34/x}}
=5^{(48-26-34)/x}
=5^{-12/x}.
\]
Powers of \(5\) strictly increase with their exponents, so equal powers have equal exponents. Hence
\[
-4=-\frac{12}{x},\qquad -4x=-12,\qquad x=3.
\]
This value is nonzero and makes the right side \(5^{-4}=25^{-2}\). Thus \(\boxed{x=3}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
